name: HATCHBOX 3D (Hatchbox Inc.)
summary: Long-running Amazon-first US filament label, trading since at least 2014 (HB HATCHBOX trademarks filed 2014/2015). Hatchbox is a brand/importer rather than a factory: standard lines have historically been described as Chinese-manufactured, while the separate PLA MAX line is marketed as USA-made. No specific OEM has been confirmed.

product_lines.name: PLA
product_lines.notes: SDS describes a 'biodegradable polymer-blend based on polylactic acid' (CAS 9051-89-2), i.e. a PLA blend rather than confirmed neat PLA. Core 1 kg line; 1 kg black listed at $21.99.

product_lines.name: PLA PRO+
product_lines.notes: Enhanced-performance/toughened PLA line sitting above base PLA.

product_lines.name: PLA MAX
product_lines.notes: 'USA Made' premium PLA line. Marketed as premium and biobased but no impact-modifier claim is published, so it is not mapped to pla-plus.

product_lines.name: PLA CF (Carbon Fiber)
product_lines.notes: Carbon-fibre-filled PLA; fibre loading not published.

product_lines.name: Metallic Finish PLA (PLA Metal)
product_lines.notes: Metallic-sheen pigmented PLA with no confirmed metal-powder loading, so it is deliberately NOT mapped to pla-metal (which covers genuinely metal-filled grades).

product_lines.name: UV Color Changing PLA
product_lines.notes: Photochromic-pigment PLA; base resin is PLA and the catalog has no photochromic id (see gaps).

product_lines.name: Wood PLA
product_lines.notes: 'Blending a mixture of plant-based materials and polymers' - PLA plus wood fibre. Wood percentage not published; no heated bed required.

product_lines.name: Glow PLA
product_lines.notes: Phosphorescent pigment in a PLA base.

product_lines.name: Glow ABS
product_lines.notes: Phosphorescent pigment in an ABS base. Maps to abs only; the catalog has no glow-in-the-dark ABS id (see gaps).

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: Shore 95A confirmed across all colourway listings, so the tpu-95a grade id applies as well as base tpu.

product_lines.name: Reload Series
product_lines.notes: Spoolless refill packaging of the base chemistries above; no distinct resin, and the exact set of chemistries offered spoolless is not enumerated, so no filament_ids are asserted.

product_lines.name: Cleaning Filament
product_lines.notes: Abrasive purge/nozzle-cleaning compound, not a structural build material; base polymer not specified and no catalog id applies.

additional_notes: Corporate address is not published on the official site and did not surface in trademark records beyond the owner name Hatchbox Inc.; US base is inferred from Amazon/US retail presence and from the 'USA Made' line being marketed as a distinct exception. Manufacturing origin for standard lines rests on a 2018 retailer account (Printed Solid) describing Hatchbox as 'a Chinese manufactured filament' sold wholesale, alongside a note that the wholesale program was discontinued after 2017-2018 supply issues; whether that remains current is unverified. Also sells 3D printer resin. Instagram and Facebook entries were assembled from the handles @hatchbox3d and HATCHBOX3D cited in research rather than from links captured directly. No build plates or print surfaces were found, but this is an unverified negative so makes_plates is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: Manufacturing origin is split and only partly evidenced: the 'China' entry comes from a single 2018 third-party retailer blog post, while 'United States' comes from Hatchbox's own PLA MAX marketing. No OEM factory is named by any source, and headquarters location is inferred rather than documented.
